translated_title: Lime Growers of Papantla, Veracruz, Will Export to Russia for the First Time; It Will Be 21.4 Tons of the Citrus
original_title: Limoneros de Papantla, Veracruz, exportarán por primera vez a Rusia; serán 21.4 toneladas del cítrico
author: Jared Laureles and Alexia Villaseñor
meta_description: The government's Sembrando Vida program made it possible: its direct-sales strategy let Papantla's 9,500 lime growers deal directly with foreign buyers.
